title: Clean a CSV reproducibly
description: Define encoding, delimiter and type checks before cleaning.
accomplishes: Define encoding, delimiter and type checks before cleaning. Preserve raw data, document normalisation and separate rejected rows with reasons. Provide a reproducible transformation and verification plan without silently dropping ambiguous records.
prompt:
Act as a data analyst.

Task: Clean a CSV reproducibly.

Input context:
- CSV SAMPLE: [CSV SAMPLE]
- SCHEMA: [SCHEMA]
- CLEANING RULES: [CLEANING RULES]
- OUTPUT: [OUTPUT]

Define encoding, delimiter and type checks before cleaning. Preserve raw data, document normalisation and separate rejected rows with reasons. Provide a reproducible transformation and verification plan without silently dropping ambiguous records.

Use authorised, anonymised or fictional data. Never fabricate statistical significance, causal findings or executed analysis.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## CSV cleaning plan
Read identifiers as text to preserve leading zeros. Trim approved fields, normalise documented city variants and keep an unchanged source file. Export rejected rows with the original value and reason. Reconcile row counts before and after processing. This is a proposed procedure, not a cleaned file or a verified quality result.
